role_in_parent: This is the arithmetic core: after reduction to grid points, it gives the global upper bound and the unique equality case.
statement_nl: For every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, F_n(j/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if j = n - 1.

domain_restrictions: n is such that the range 0 <= j <= n - 1 is not contradictory (intended requirement: n >= 1)
the expression j/n is in the domain where F_n is defined (intended: F_n is defined at rational inputs of the form j/n)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For a fixed parameter n (intended n >= 1), for every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, the value F_n(j/n) is at most H_n minus 1, and F_n(j/n) equals H_n minus 1 exactly when j equals n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all j (integer), with 0 <= j <= n - 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: parameter indexing the functions F_n and the value H_n; also determines the range 0 <= j <= n - 1

variables.name: j
variables.role: loop variable ranging over the integer indices in 0 <= j <= n - 1

witness_dependencies: the equality case is pinned by the specific witness value j = n - 1; no separate existential witness is introduced beyond this equivalence condition
